mission: Dated NET-NEW reasoning spike: P1 builds the G-entailment/rules fixture (g-entailment-rules/v1: twenty cases in five classes under the restricted EYE pins, no negation class), then P2-P4 run the adhd probes (proof-ledger kernel, budget-certified rules, evidence-graph workspace) as kill criteria ablated against EYE, with the v3 rete salvage entering at P3 once the archive is located; one S1 candidate (MAP v1.1 section R, R2).

provenance.note: MAP v1.1 re-entry packet R (DECISIONS 2026-09-03 R2, ratified with R2.a-R2.g, R0.a, R1.g). The v1.0 precondition 'G-entailment/rules fixture committed' had no owner and became this packet's P1 (R2.a); the C2 pass (2026-08-31) satisfied the other. P2-P4 and the R-c class wait for the sibling semantica-storage-inversion's P-S1 (R1.g); the archived beep-effect-logos root must be located before P3 (R2.g). The O4 OSS gate reasoning-package stays behind this spike surviving ablation.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

stopConditions: Probe breaker (S1 as amended by R0.a): P1-P4 are one stage of the reasoning family's opening candidate; a failed probe buys exactly one more candidate for that probe, redesigned when the failure was a design fault; a second failure parks the family, records the park in explorations/semantica-lab/DECISIONS.md, and drops the exploration back to decompose. Never a calendar.
P2-P4 and the R-c fixture class cannot start until semantica-storage-inversion's P-S1 has landed (R1.g); R-a, R-b, R-d and R-e build in parallel with the storage spike.
P3 (P-R2) cannot start until the archived beep-effect-logos root is located and its LICENSE re-verified as Apache-2.0; until then the rete salvage is reference-only (R2.g).

Kill criteria per probe: canonicalization drift across premise-order permutations or cold replays (P2); certificate unsoundness, unsound admission or bounds that reject real rules (P3); unstable identity or invalidation across re-extraction and replay (P4).

Any change to the pinned g-entailment-rdfs/v1 fixture or its seven C2 cases; any change to the EYE oracle pins without regenerating every gold; a negation case added to gold/v1 before restricted EYE is shown to accept scoped negation (R2.b, R2.d).
A fixture-local retraction law that differs from the ledger's Invalidated semantics (R2.e); a rules expectation that asks EYE for something it cannot independently establish (R2.c).
A change would cross a BRIEF No-Go (the spike is never the M1 runtime; no reusable @beep/* export from the lab; the reasoning-package OSS gate stays closed until ablation is survived).
Verification requires credentials, cost, destructive side effects, or policy approval not named in SPEC.md.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
statusNote: Scaffolded 2026-09-03 at the semantica-lab graduation ceremony (MAP v1.1 §R, R2); execution not started. P1 (the g-entailment-rules/v1 fixture, minus R-c) can begin now; R-c and P2-P4 wait for semantica-storage-inversion P-S1; P3 waits for the archived beep-effect-logos root to be located.
